text: Site "Susquehanna Works": Dauphin County, PA. 80 MW solar + 20 MW storage, COD 2029. Former steel mill site, already zoned industrial, land under option. The substation is 0.5 miles away across our own parcel (1 parcel). No wetlands on the site survey. Nearest homes are over a mile away, and there were no objections at the pre-application meeting.
